text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Altura Labs was double-charged for a Reserved pool line on invoice INV-3421. Looks like a pricing-experiment flag and reserved metering overlap. Can we triage and get a manual credit out?

Maria Gonzales: Ugh, ok. Can you paste the invoice lines and any meter logs?

Alex Chen: Here are the invoice lines (redacted):
```
INV-3421
 - Reserved capacity (region-us-west) x1  2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30  $15,000.00
 - Reserved capacity (region-us-west) x1  2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30  $15,000.00  <-- duplicate
 - Usage overage (tokens)  $1,230.45
Total: $31,230.45
```

June (billing-bot): detected event: pricing_experiment=rollout_v3 enabled for customer_id=ALTURA-88 at 2025-06-01T00:02:12Z; reserved_meter wrote reserve_charge for pool_id=usw-03 twice (seq 9012, 9013).

Samir Patel: Quick Q — was the experiment supposed to touch reserved billing? If yes, should have been gated.

Alex Chen: Not supposed to. Root cause: experiment toggled a new billing path that didn't check idempotency for reserved allocations. Duplicate charge persisted for full billing period (30d). We ran a reconcile and found duplicate charge active for 30 days.

Alex Chen: Proposed remediation: issue manual credit = prorated duplicate reserved charge for the billing period (100% of duplicate line) minus any valid usage adjustments, plus one-time goodwill for the SLA confusion. Breakdown: 
 - Duplicate reserved line: $15,000.00
 - Usage corrections (customer actually used seats, so we keep $1,230.45 usage)
 - Recommended goodwill: $1,500.00 (customer impacted support time + SLA annoyance)
 - Total credit to issue: $15,000.00 + $1,500.00 = $16,500.00

Ken Park: That's >$10k. Per policy, Lina needs to OK any goodwill >$10k; GL code for credits is 4210.CRED. Also need accounting ticket and credit memo. I'll route if Lina approves. :eyes:

Maria Gonzales: Can we lower goodwill? Customer NPS low but still small. Alternatively, issue full duplicate reversal ($15k) + $500 goodwill = $15,500. What's the minimum to avoid escalation?

Alex Chen: We should be conservative. Customer lost trust; support logged two escalation calls. Recommend $1,500 as above. But fine to move to $500 if Ops thinks so.

Lina Ortiz: I reviewed logs and the support thread. Approving manual credit of $16,500 as one-time goodwill reversal. Please tag as "goodwill - SLA/experiment" and route to AR with GL 4210.CRED. Approved by Lina Ortiz, Director Finance. :white_check_mark:

Ken Park: Got it — I'll open accounting ticket and push credit memo. GL 4210.CRED, memo: CM-ALTURA-1735567890. Notifying customer success to send comms.

Maria Gonzales: I'll create the credit memo in the billing system, mark reason = "duplicate reserved charge + goodwill (experiment)" and attach invoice INV-3421 & logs.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. I'll add a follow-up: disable experiment, deploy idempotency guard, and add an alert if reserved_meter writes >1 charge per billing period per pool.

Ken Park: Please cc finance@redwood when you push the ticket. Closing thread after ticket created.

Alex Chen: CC'd. Thanks team. :handshake:
